s1.desc: a dining corner with a round table and a wooden chair, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a living room with a cream couch, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s3.desc: a park with a wooden bench in front of snowy pine trees under a pale sky

s4.desc: a fast food counter drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a plate on the table in front of him

beats.text: Pax sits at the table and slices the sandwich on his plate in half with a knife
Pax lays the knife down beside his plate and blinks, looking ahead
Pax picks up one sandwich half and lifts it to his beak, his eyes wide open
Pax closes his eyes and bites into the sandwich as a fin edges in from the right
Pax chews with his eyes closed while the fin reaches toward his plate
Pax opens his eyes while the fin takes the other sandwich half off his plate and pulls it away to the right
Pax holds his sandwich half at his beak and chews, looking ahead with wide eyes
Pax chews his sandwich with his eyes shut and his beak open

spans.notes: only Polly's fin reaches in (f54-76), so Polly is not listed as a character | verification pass 2 (verify3_report_1): Beat 54-76 keeps Pax's eyes closed, but he opens them at f66, before the fin takes the second sandwich half (f67-74).; Beat 76-105 says Pax opens his eyes and smiles; his eyes are already open from f66, and from f87 to the end he chews with his eyes shut and his beak open.; Beat 32-54 says he chews with his eyes closed, but they are wide open f32-45 while he lifts the sandwich and only close at f4

beats.text: Pax sits on the couch hugging a striped popcorn bucket and scoops up some popcorn with his fin
Pax lifts the popcorn to his beak and munches it
Pax chews while a fin reaches in from the left, grabs a handful of popcorn from his bucket and pulls back out of view
Pax glances to the left with wide eyes
Pax closes his eyes in a soft, contented smile, holding the bucket

spans.notes: only Polly's fin reaches in (f141-159), so Polly is not listed as a character

beats.text: Pax sits on the bench licking a scoop of green ice cream on a cone
Pax keeps licking the ice cream with his eyes closed and a contented smile
Pax opens his eyes in surprise while fins reach in from the right, take his green cone and put a red ice cream cone in his fin
Pax holds the red ice cream cone, looking at it, then smiles with his eyes closed

spans.notes: only Polly's fins reach in (f208-228), so Polly is not listed as a character; clouds drift slightly

spans.view: with a paper bag and a burger box on the counter

beats.text: Pax sits behind the counter, pulls a few fries from a striped bucket and pops them in his beak
Pax chews with the fries sticking out of his beak, looking ahead
Pax reaches into the bucket and picks out another fry, the fries still hanging from his beak
Pax holds still with a fry in his flipper while a fin reaches in from the right and plucks a fry from his bucket
Pax holds still as the fin reaches up, pulls the fries out of his beak and slips away to the right
Pax blinks, then stares ahead with wide eyes, holding a fry in his flipper

spans.notes: only Polly's fin reaches in (f268-292), so Polly is not listed as a character; a fast zoom out starts at f307 | verification pass 2 (verify3_report_1): Beat 250-268 says Pax only chews and looks ahead, but from f256 to f266 he reaches into the bucket and picks out another fry, which he then holds for the rest of the span.; Beat 268-283: the fin takes one fry from the bucket (f276-280), not 'a few'. The fin first appears at f266.; Beat 292-307 says 'a fry in his fin'; it is his flipper (the fin in this span is the other character's).; Camera locke
fast 4-frame zoom out revealing Polly next to Pax

spans.view: with a paper bag and a burger box on the long counter

beats.text: Polly munches fries with her eyes closed and a happy smile while Pax holds a fry and watches her
Pax nibbles his fry with his eyes closed while Polly keeps munching
Polly opens her eyes and looks over at Pax with blushing cheeks
Polly leans across toward Pax, bringing her face up to his cheek
Polly kisses Pax on the cheek as they both blush and a little red heart pops up above them
